title: JWorkflow Workbench whole-change-set proposal
description: Returned by POST /api/project/changes and GET /api/project/changes/revert. Approval sends back the token; the server recomputes the proposal and rejects any difference.

token.description: SHA-256 over operation, revision, document hash, package, discovery, profile, manual-edit flag and every path with before/after hashes.

revision.description: Saved workflow revision the proposal was generated from; 0 for a revert.

manualGroovyEdit.description: The Groovy file differs from what Workbench last wrote; applying needs explicit replacement confirmation.

path.description: Path relative to the confirmed project root.

beforeHash.description: SHA-256 of current UTF-8 content, empty when absent.

afterHash.description: SHA-256 of proposed UTF-8 content, empty when deleted.

diff.description: Complete unified diff; changed lines are never omitted.
